1.w: A song of ascents. Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be moved and will endure forever.

2.w: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord surrounds his people, now and forevermore.

3.w: Indeed, the scepter of a wicked king will not settle upon the allotted land of the godly. Otherwise the godly might do what is wrong.

4.w: Do good, O Lord, to those who are good, to the morally upright.

5.w: As for those who are bent on traveling a sinful path, may the Lord remove them, along with those who behave wickedly. May Israel experience peace.
